extracted.summary: The National Fellowship Scheme for Scheduled Caste Students provides financial assistance to SC students pursuing M.Phil or Ph.D. degrees in Science, Humanities, or Social Science at UGC‑recognised institutions.
extracted.amount_text: INR 37,000 per month for the initial two years as Junior Research Fellow.
extracted.categories_quote: Applicants must belong to the Scheduled Caste category as per state government lists.
extracted.course_levels_quote: Applicants must be pursuing regular full-time M.Phil/Ph.D. courses at UGC-recognised universities.
